title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Benefits: Tier Reduction on Free Night Awards Walked Nights
content:
For one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated, the member's elite tier lowers the walked-night protected price. The tier reduction is the upper walked tier reduction for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member, the lower walked tier reduction for a Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member, and nothing for every other member. It is taken off the walked-night protected price once.

- Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite: 5000 points, the upper walked tier reduction.
- Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite: 5000 points, the upper walked tier reduction.
- Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite: 2500 points, the lower walked tier reduction.
- Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite: 2500 points, the lower walked tier reduction.
- Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite and Ashbury Rewards Member: no tier reduction.

The tier is the elite tier currently held, as the Ashbury Rewards membership record shows it.
